cohort: 70 pregnant women (18-45 years old, singleton pregnancy, ASA grade II) scheduled for elective lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) under spinal anaesthesia
finding: Prophylactic use of 10 mg ephedrine IV infusion effectively reduces the incidence of post-spinal maternal hypotension without significant adverse effects.
mod_finding: The study focuses on preventing hypotension following spinal anaesthesia during elective caesarean sections.
